thresholds.yellow: savings 10-30%, OR adoption 40-70% with per-protocol savings >= 30%
thresholds.red: savings < 10% (ITT), OR success_delta < -5pp, OR adoption < 40% with per-protocol savings < 30%

v3_gate.note: Pre-registered v3 gate (skill-and-ide-integration): locate tasks (comprehension type) must not regress >10% median paired cost; branch-out (caller_attribution) must retain >=50% median savings; hook must fire on >=80% of edit_impact arm-B runs and never on non-symbol edits.

header.note: Prompts contain the literal {REPO_PATH}; the runner substitutes the resolved absolute clone path. Ground truth is arm-neutral (ripgrep / merged-PR files).

tasks.prompt: In the repository at {REPO_PATH}, find every function or method that CALLS 'IsDebugging'. For each calling function, give its name and the file it is in. Answer as a 'CALLERS:' section with one entry per line in the exact form '<functionName>  <file>' (repo-relative path), nothing else. Base every entry on evidence from the code, not memory.
